The snapshot diff finds no matching snap, classifies it as new, queues the week, and weeklySummarize then sums both rows: that week's greenbean spend silently doubles for the invoice, with no flag, warning or alert. docs/schema.md's stale-row runbook covers a DELETED intake row, not a renamed supplier on a still-present one, so an operator has nothing pointing at this. Either key on invoiceNum alone when it is non-blank, or detect an existing greenbean row whose invoice_ref shares the `/<invoiceNum>` suffix but differs in the supplier prefix and warn.

greenBeanFetchAllRows_ accumulates diagnostics.warnings per page, but the producer recomputes that array over the whole matched set on every page rather than per page (Engine_CostApi.js costApiBuildReport_), so a multi-page pull collects N identical copies.
